label.source: BC Aerial Overview Survey / Pest Infestation Polygons - Current

caveats: AOS label is the 2025 current Pest Infestation Polygons layer; it is not the 2002-2020 AOS series used by Brown et al. (2025).
BEAST does not attribute the agent; IDW is the AOS label, not a BEAST classification.
The 2023 event precedes the 2025 AOS capture by two years; this is reported as early detection, not same-year agreement.
The 2018 event is also inside the block but seven years before the AOS capture; its cause is not attributed.
2025 annual maximum inside the block was 0.469, below the 0.5 threshold.
